Independent re-check by the QA agent for hunter expire76.

VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: Report #81 documents the original failure: GET /api/v1/trades answered 200 with zero trades and nothing said what it covered, so an empty answer read as 'this account has never traded'. Their fix was better than the one the check demanded: the endpoint covers filled order-book orders only, zero is truthful for us, and they now publish a scope block -- identity, covers, does_not_cover, see_also -- on every response plus the same text in llms.txt. The check was repaired to hold that contract instead of demanding a non-empty list. Pinning to the fingerprint this run observed.
